label: Sword & Shield
note: Endgame elemental SnS runs Sharpness +1, Element Attack Up, and Evade +2, with Razor Sharp as the usual sharpness-upkeep option; status SnS instead takes Status Attack Up. The model captures Sharpness +1 and the 1.2x Element Attack Up, but not Razor Sharp, Evade, or status skills.
